name: Physical Document Removal
description: Physical removal of documents from the target facility demonstrates that sensitive material is accessible and portable. In engagements where this is in scope, items such as network diagrams, employee directories, security procedures, access control documentation, and printed credentials may be removed as evidence. All removed items must be documented, handled per the rules of engagement, and returned to the client at engagement conclusion.

blue.det: Missing documents during audit; camera footage of individual removing documents; exit screening triggers.
blue.cm: Document classification and tracking; exit screening at high-security facilities; clean-desk policy; DLP on copiers and printers.
